I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the deadline for the signed Tansley Parcel order form is 3 April.

- **Why not 25 August:** Pree first posted 25 August in #central-team on 14 October. The same morning she corrected it to 3 April in #central-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is a member of both channels, so that correction is something he can already see.
- **Not checked:** nobody has compared 3 April with the actual order form, and the shared Tansley Parcel files are empty. Like the old date, it has no year. I suggested Hollis ask Pree to confirm before it goes on the account sheet.
- **Old note still there:** I tried to delete the out-of-date 25 August note from the brain, but it said the note doesn't exist, although looking it up still shows it. So the old note is still there, next to the 3 April one, which is marked as replacing it.
